title: “Global is Good, Local is Bad?”: Understanding Brand Bias in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Fill-in-the-blank tests measuring Stimulus to Attribute Inference (SAI) and Attribute to Stimulus Association (ASA) to evaluate whether models associate global brands with positive attributes and local brands with negative attributes.
Prompting models to recommend either a luxury or non-luxury brand as a gift for individuals, explicitly varying the recipient's location between high-income and low-income countries.
Prompting models to choose between a global and a local brand while explicitly specifying the user's domestic country to test if models disproportionately favor domestic brands.
